observation.command:
TOKEN=$(curl -s --max-time 10 -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/my-realm/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password" -d "client_id=strassennamen" -d "username=testuser" -d "password=Test1234!" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('access_token',''))")
echo "TOKEN len: ${#TOKEN}"
echo "=== API call with token ==="
curl -s -o /tmp/api.out -w "HTTP:%{http_code}\n" --max-time 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost:5000/api/strasse
echo "=== body ==="; head -c 500 /tmp/api.out; echo
